description: Prepare a professional appraisal screening packet from item context before an appraiser starts or reviews a Pro Screener case. Use this for credentialed appraisers and valuation teams who need missing-photo checks, missing-fact checks, review flags, and next questions. This tool organizes research inputs only; it does not issue a final value conclusion or signed appraisal.

availablePhotos.description: Available photo types such as front, back, signature, label, condition, scale, underside.

intendedUse.description: Professional use case such as triage, insurance, estate, donation, resale, or report prep.

itemCategory.description: Item category such as oil painting, silver bowl, antique chair, jewelry, ceramic vase, or sculpture.

knownFacts.description: Known facts from the client or appraiser notes.

subjectDescription.description: Short professional description of the item, visible features, medium/materials, and context.

targetValueUsd.description: Optional client-stated or working reference value in USD.

name: prepare_pro_screener_case_packet
title: Prepare Pro Screener Case Packet
